Recently took our dog here for heart worm treatment referred by another ver. I advised to Emancipet that our dog has been on Doxy since January (with resting months in between) and was told by emancipet that before he was due for his heartworm shot in October, he was to take 1050mg of doxcy (600mg in morning, 550mg at night), YES per day, before doing the injection. This raised a red flag as our boy has been on Doxy with initially starting 800mg a day (back in Jan) to eventually moving towards 1time a day at 400mg by June.  However, the tech (we did not speak with a vet at all) advised due to his weight he would need this much. A week into the doxy, our boy was not being himself. To the point where he started to physically reject the pills, something hes NEVER done before. His appetite decreased, he stopped eating, and was having nausea episodes of vomiting. This wasn’t just a “oh he’s probably nauseous from the doxy” situation. This was surpassing nausea as something was seriously wrong with our fur baby. We took him to an emergency vet appointment where our vet (along with another vet at a different location) advised our dog should only be getting 10mg of doxy PER kg of weight PER DAY. Our dog weighs 115lbs =52kgs. This means his size indicates he should have been taking 520mg of doxy per day…NOT 1050mg. That is twice the limit for him which makes sense why he became sick and to reiterate this was more MG’s than what he had been previously prescribed since having him (which was relayed to tech) Given that he had responded well to Doxy in the past this was extremely scary for us as our dog was not himself for almost 2 weeks. Per our Vet suggestion, we have moved him now to 520mg a day and he showed immediate improvement within 2 days with only needing nausea medication for 1 day. Thank God, He is back to normal eating his kibble, something he wouldn’t even look at when put in front of him. And he loves to eat. His energy is back. I tried calling the number the first time, I had to leave a message for a call back which happened the following day, assuming they use an answering service of some kind. I wish there was someone I could speak to about this  because this could have ended badly with our boy no longer being with us. I would really like an opportunity for a phone call so someone can explain what went wrong here and how it can be avoided in the future.
